plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Siemens SCALANCE industrial switches (enterprise PEN 4329). It reports uptime, interface traffic, power supply status (AUTOMATION-PS), per-sensor temperature and the device fault-signalling state (SN-MSPS-SCX200-MIB).
name: Switch

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of the SCALANCE industrial switch from automationPSStatus, normalised so that active(2) maps to 1=normal and inactive(1)/other values map to 2=abnormal.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor chassis temperature of the SCALANCE industrial switch in whole degrees Celsius (SN-MSPS-SCX200-MIB snMspsDiagnosticsTemperatureValue). Rows that are not present, have invalid/initial status, or fall outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: scalance_fault_state
metrics.description: Fault LED / signalling-contact state of the SCALANCE industrial switch (SN-MSPS-SCX200-MIB snMspsFaultState). noFault(1) maps to 1=normal and fault(2) maps to 2=abnormal; any other value is dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
